title: Community health programme delivery evidence review

sources.text: Programme plan P-12 targets monthly health education sessions in five community sites.
Delivery log: 18 sessions recorded across five sites in September 2026; attendance sheets were supplied for 15 sessions.
Coordinator note: three sessions have no attached attendance sheet and participant reach is therefore incomplete.
